paragraphs: Rabbi Yonah and Rabbi Chiyya and Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish, in Rabbi Yudan Nesia’s name; see his entry. In Rabbi Abaye’s name: Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 5:2:2 (cited here as 5:7). And Rabbi Acha bar Huna; Rabbi Acha bar Ulla; Rabbi Inai bar Sisi. In Rabbi Elazar’s name. Rabbi Elazar ben Marom was before him. Rabbi Ammi; Rabbi Ashyan; Rabbi Bun bar Kahana; Rabbi Guryon. In Rabbi Hoshaya’s name: Maaser Sheni 2:1. Rabbi Chelbo bar Vallas. In Rabbi Hamnuna’s name: Maaserot 4:2. Rabbi Zevadyah ben Yaakov bar Zavdi transmitted in his name. Rabbi Zeira said; see above. Rabbi Zeaira was his teacher. In Rabbi Huna’s name. In Chizkiyah’s name. In Rabbi Chiyya bar Ba’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Chomer BaKodesh. In Rabbi Chiyya bar Vava’s name: end of Bikkurim. Rabbi Chiyya bar Medaya asked before him. Rabbi Chama bar Ukva said. Rabbi Chanina Anatnaya. In Rabbi Chisda’s name. Rabbi Yehudah bar Pedayah raised an objection before him. Rabbi Yehoshua Deromaya. Rabbi Yochanan ben Katzart transmitted in his name. Rabbi Yose Gelila. In Rabbi Yasa bar Chanina’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 3. Rabbi Yose; Rabbi Yose ben Nezira; Rabbi Yose Deromi was before him. Rabbi Yitzchak ben Tavlai. Rabbi Yitzchak Kritzpa transmitted in his name, as did Rabbi Levanti. Rabbi Meyasha said. Rav Nachman bar Adda. Nicha bar Sava asked him. In Rabbi Nasa’s name, and Rabbi Nasa in his name. Natan Sava. Ulla bar Yishmael. He found Rabbi Ilai. Rabbi Pedayah. Pelofi bar Peruta was before him. Rabbi Pinchas HaChaver transmitted in his name. In Bar Kappara’s name: beginning of Jerusalem Talmud, Yoma. In Rabbi Keruspa’s name. Rava bar Chiyya. Rabbi Redifa. Rabbi Shmuel Kappadokaya said: Challah, chapter 3. In Rabbi Shimon Chasida’s name. In Rabbi Shimon ben Zekharyah’s name. And Rabbi Berekhiah in Resh Lakish’s name: Bereshit Rabbah, section 100. In Rabbi Tanchum bar Chiyya’s name.
